description: Kardiologie: IPS-Verlegung 2025 (primär) + Diagnoseliste + Austrittsbericht; je Variable eigene LLM-Abfrage und Textquelle. Re-Op/Re-Thor/Grund aus ReOP-Bericht (fehlender Fall = Nein). SWI out of scope.

text_sources.reoperation_required: reop (ReOP-Bericht; missing case = Nein); fallback both

policy.confirmed: Neu / TIA / Schlaganfall / Ja (status-spezifisch; Zirrhose: Child-Pugh A|B|C|unbekannt)
policy.unclear_or_suspicion: Unbekannt (incl. V.a. alone; temporary pacemaker alone; organ failure without explicit MOV)
policy.reoperation: Ja only if further OP during same stay; Index-Redo alone ≠ Ja
policy.reop_source: HER_*REOP* export lists only cases with a follow-up OP: when loaded, absent FallNummer → Nein/Keine without LLM call; not loaded → fallback text source
policy.deferred: SWI Superficial/Deep (out of scope for LLM); reoperation_reason → Dendrite code mapping; general HER_OP_Bericht loader
policy.evidence_quotes: array of {column, quote}; export as column: "verbatim sentence"
policy.swi: sternal wound infection is out of scope for LLM extraction
policy.verlegung_source: HER_IPS_Verlegungsbericht* default discover (ips_only=True); classic HER_Verlegungsbericht* via explicit --reports (e.g. 2026)
